SourceString: Stunning or pulling an enemy Vanguard shields Cairn. The same enemy cannot shield him again for a while.
Throws a hook that pushes other units aside and pulls the first enemy Vanguard it hits back to Cairn.
Slams the ground in front of him: close enemies are damaged and stunned, those further out are slowed.
Braces: he takes less damage and is moved less far, but walks slower, and nearby allies take less damage. Cast again to stop early.
Drags nearby enemies in, damaging and stunning them and slowing those further out; he gains a shield for each enemy Vanguard caught.
Strikes every enemy close around you with a short physical cleave.
Attacking the same enemy Vanguard again and again speeds up his attacks. Switching targets or leaving combat loses it.
Empowers his next basic attack: extra damage and a slow, and it cleaves enemies around the target.
Shields him briefly, and crowd control on him wears off faster.
Dashes toward the cursor and stops at the first enemy, damaging it; hitting one gives him a burst of speed.
After a short windup, cleaves a wide arc in front of him and knocks enemies aside. Hitting an enemy Vanguard sends him into a frenzy: faster, cleaving attacks and a rush toward enemy Vanguards.
Damaging abilities that hit an enemy Vanguard gather light. After three, her next hit also fires a fragment of light for extra magic damage.
Throws a lance of light that damages the first enemy it hits.
Marks an area; after a moment, light strikes it, damaging and slowing enemies inside.
Shields her briefly and gives her a burst of speed.
Channels a long beam of light in front of her, damaging enemies in it again and again.
Every third attack in a row on an enemy Vanguard breaches it: extra damage, and a blast that hits enemies behind it.
Loads her next basic attack: it ignores part of the target's armor, deals extra damage, and blasts enemies behind the target.
Fires a flare at a spot, slowing enemies there.
Blasts a cone toward the cursor, damaging and slowing enemies, and the recoil throws her backward.
Calls a broadside on an area: after a moment it lands, dealing heavy damage in the middle, more to wounded enemies, and less around it.

An enemy Vanguard that he or an ally knocks or pulls becomes Tracked: he reaches further against it and his attacks deal extra damage. The distance they are moved builds toward Dead Reckoning, which empowers his next attack on a Tracked target.
A long precision shot that passes through every enemy in its line.
Marks out a firing corridor ahead of him for a few seconds: he attacks faster inside it, allies move faster along it, and it shows what ordinary sight would.
Fires a shot that knocks the first enemy back, and the recoil throws him backward.
Plants himself and opens a long firing lane: he may fire three piercing shots down it, and an ally moving a Tracked enemy earns him more.
Fires a piercing shot down the lane.
Each basic attack adds Attack Speed, which falls away a stack at a time once she stops. At full Cadence a spectral echo repeats each attack for part of its damage.
A deliberate long shot. Its target becomes Ranged: she reaches further against it, and her attacks on it build Cadence faster.
Takes a firing stance she cannot move from: more range and Attack Speed, resistance to slows and knockbacks, and slower Cadence decay. Cast again to leave it.
A stronger firing stance, during The Last Volley. Cast again to leave it.
A close spectral volley in a cone that damages and knocks enemies back, spending her Cadence.
Reaches full Cadence at once and holds it, raises her Attack Speed ceiling, and every third attack sends a spectral rank firing through her target.
Her attacks on enemy Vanguards add Hex, and her damaging abilities add two. An attack on a target with two Hex spends them for extra magic damage.
A straight magic bolt that damages the first enemy hit and gives it two Hex.
Tosses a trinket that explodes after a moment, damaging and briefly slowing enemies and giving them two Hex.
Camouflage and extra speed for a few seconds. Her first attack after empowers: extra damage and two Hex on a target not yet primed.
Throws both rings into an area for a magic blast that gives two Hex. For a while after, each Hex she spends sends a bolt at another enemy Vanguard nearby.
The first enemy Vanguard to damage him becomes Haunted for a while. If it damages one of his allies nearby instead, the spirit lashes it with magic damage and a brief slow.
Leaps at an enemy Vanguard and holds on, dealing magic damage and heavily slowing it; he is dragged along wherever it goes. Recast to let go, thrown backward, and make it stumble.
The Thing Inside holds on harder: more magic damage, a heavier slow, and longer.
Throws him backward off the enemy he holds, which stumbles the other way.
Collapses into an ordinary-looking teddy: he cannot act or be moved and takes much less damage. As it ends, enemies nearby are feared, for longer the more they attacked him.
Tethers an enemy Vanguard to him, revealing it to his team. If it pulls too far away, the tether snaps it back toward him once and breaks.

A huge spectral bear manifests around him: temporary Health, a far larger body that is harder to move, a chill that slows enemies near him, and a stronger Bear Hug, until it collapses back into the toy.
Helping clear a whole jungle camp restores some Health and gives a burst of speed, once per camp. Taking down an enemy Vanguard does the same, on its own cooldown.
Lunges a short way, dragging both cleavers through every enemy in his path for physical damage, more against wildlife.
Hunting: each enemy Vanguard it hits speeds him toward that Vanguard for a moment.
Two wide sweeps around him while he moves slowly, the second harder on wildlife. Wildlife it hits restores his Health, up to a limit each cast.
Hunting: each enemy Vanguard it hits speeds him toward that Vanguard for a moment.
Leaps to a visible spot, dealing minor physical damage where he lands.
A short hunting frenzy: faster attacks that hit enemy Vanguards harder, and Rip Through and Furnace Rake speed him toward the Vanguards they hit. Takedowns extend it, up to a limit.

Moving, attacking and casting build Momentum. At full, her next basic ability is Redlined, and her next attack on an enemy Vanguard becomes Roadhouse: a lunge with extra physical damage from its missing Health and her bonus Health.
Lunges and hooks the first enemy she reaches for physical damage. Recast to drive on through for more.
Drives on through, damaging every enemy in her path.
Redlined: a heavier lunge that hits harder and knocks the enemy back.
Braces toward the front, taking much less damage from that side. A hit landing while she braces lets her counter, slowing enemies around her.

Hound arrives and she rides: very fast, passing through units and turning wide, but unable to attack. Mounted, her abilities become Sideswipe, Powerslide and Bail Out; as the ride ends Hound rolls on and knocks enemies back.
An extreme ride: enormous speed and Unstoppable. Recast for Last Exit, which fires by itself as the ride ends.
A mounted pass that damages every enemy along it.
Slides Hound around, damaging and slowing enemies in front of her.
Jumps free of Hound, which rolls on and knocks enemies back.
Launches from Hound and crashes down, damaging and knocking up enemies where she lands, while Hound rolls on through the rest.
Use it to restore Health over a few seconds. Each is used up; one restores at a time.
Use it to restore Health over a few seconds. It holds charges, refilled at your fountain and when your side secures a Flux Well.
Amplifies your total Magic Power by a percentage.
Active, Cleave: strike every enemy close around you.
Weight of War: gain Physical Power from a share of your bonus Health.
Spool Up: basic attacks on enemy Vanguards stack Attack Speed for a short time, up to a cap.
Overcycle: ability hits on enemy Vanguards stack Ability Haste for a short time, up to a cap.
Overcharge: increase your total Magic Power by a percentage.
Perfect Cut: your critical strikes deal increased damage.
Reprisal Guard: damaging an enemy Vanguard shields you for a share of the damage dealt, then waits.
Convergence: an ability hit primes an enemy Vanguard; your next ability hit on it deals bonus magic damage.
Fracture: your magic damage wears down an enemy Vanguard's Magic Resistance, up to a cap.
Drag: your damaging abilities briefly slow enemy Vanguards.
Instantly blinks a short distance toward the cursor.
Restores Health to you and the most wounded allied Vanguard nearby, and briefly speeds you both.
Sets an enemy Vanguard burning, dealing True damage over 5 seconds.
Slows an enemy Vanguard and cuts the damage it deals for a few seconds.
Deals heavy True damage to a jungle creature, a Flux Well or a Fluxborn. Enough to steal a Well.
